business_problem: ENEOS Materials needed secure AI that could help a shrinking workforce perform research, plant design, training analysis, and other knowledge-heavy manufacturing tasks faster without exposing proprietary information.
solution_summary: ENEOS Materials adopted ChatGPT Enterprise as a secure company-wide foundation, then scaled usage with a cross-functional team that built more than 1,000 custom GPTs for departmental workflows. Engineers use deep research to search local-language and specialized technical sources, translate them into Japanese, and compress investigations that used to take months into minutes. Plant-design teams use a custom GPT grounded in company standards to generate specifications from inputs such as flow rate, pipe diameter, pressure loss, and material requirements while also flagging corrosion or material-selection risks. HR teams use a separate custom GPT to analyze post-training feedback and an internally built tool, created by a non-programmer with ChatGPT support, to automate data aggregation. Rather than isolate AI in one lab, ENEOS made the enterprise workspace broadly available so research, design, analysis, and employee upskilling could all run on a governed common platform.

data_flow: Technical documents, external research, plant-design parameters, and training feedback enter ChatGPT Enterprise and department-specific custom GPTs. Deep research retrieves and translates relevant materials, specialized GPTs generate design or analysis outputs, and employees review those results before applying them in operations.
business_outcome: ENEOS Materials achieved broad weekly adoption, sharply reduced research and data-analysis time, improved design speed and safety, and created a repeatable pattern for company-wide AI use in manufacturing under secure enterprise controls.
